main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Free Yourself from the Demiurge: Your Consciousness Transcends Matter
header_desc: Interweaving spirituality of the first century with twenty-first-century physics, this work addresses the primordial question about our place in the universe. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in texts two thousand years old: the Gnostic gospels.
left_title: Return ✝️ to the ONE ❤️: The ego 🧠 has mass ┻
left_body: Matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. If the ego curves space-time, the temporal plane of the cosmos emerges from our psyche, and the timeless responds to the pneuma. Consciousness oscillates between the states lvert ONE ⟩ and lvert EGO ⟩, granting us a free will of perception formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. In this context, the premise that the Father and I are one becomes a profound invitation to shed the false self to return to the pure light of the Invisible Father.
universe_light_text: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist liberates us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom is inside and outside of you – Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): the timeless light of feeling in the right hemisphere versus the temporal density of thought in the left hemisphere show the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: I invite you to invert the map ✝️ of reality and participate in the awakening of the ONE ❤️.
p2_sub: From the Material Prison to the Plērōma of Light: A Journey Through Gnosis and Physics
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle
cap1_desc: The meeting between the intuitive heart of the South and the rational mind of the North. The awakening of the collective consciousness through the reconciliation of spirit and science.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time
cap2_desc: Time as an emergent construct. The theoretical unification where the geometry of the cosmos converges with the timeless structure of quantum reality.
cap3_desc: Reality as a phenomenon of observation and perception. The collapse of the fundamental state and the quantum dynamics between pure presence and the observer.
cap4_desc: The origin of physical order according to the Gnostic gospels: the emanation of Sophia versus the material architecture of Yaldabaoth and the carbon-12 matrix.
cap5_desc: Quantum formalization of the mass of the ego: the curvature induced by mental attachment and the equation of free will in the oscillation ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Brain Hemispheres
cap6_desc: The blindness of the spiritual eye and the tyrannical dominance of the left hemisphere (disconnected reason) versus the integrative vision of the right hemisphere and the heart.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos
cap7_desc: Return to the Invisible Father: the definitive liberation from the temporal illusion, the dissolution of the material prison, and awakening in the full light of the Plērōma.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than usual, with a flowing beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the sum of physical laws that govern the universe, then there is clearly such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity
